subject: Re: Live demo scheduling — compliance attestation and exec onsite conflict
messages:
From: Hannah Lytton <hannah.lytton@clearwellhealth.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Live demo — meeting with IT & Procurement on Jan 22

Marcus / team,

Thanks for the coordination so far. Our IT and procurement teams asked for a quick confirmation: they require the vendor attestation questionnaire completed before any live demo where we'll show platform connectivity or sample data flows. I've attached the questionnaire — procurement needs a completed copy by EOD Jan 24 for an internal audit window.

Separately, our Chief Product Officer will be onsite with customers Jan 22–23 and won't be available for a virtual session those days. That makes the Jan 22 slot tight for us.

Options we have on our side:
- Complete the questionnaire and aim for a live demo the week of Jan 26 (preferably after Jan 26 midday ET), or
- Share a short screened recording of the demo this week while procurement completes the attestation, then follow with a live Q&A once the questionnaire is accepted.

Could you confirm whether you can (a) accept the requested attestation timeline and (b) either provide an async walkthrough or move the live walkthrough to Jan 27/28 afternoon ET?

I'll loop procurement for any clarification (procurement@clearwellhealth.com).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lytton
Head of Partnerships, Clearwell Health
Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v2.pdf
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lytton <hannah.lytton@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo — meeting with IT & Procurement on Jan 22

Hi Hannah — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the questionnaire.

We can work the attestation timeline. Quick notes:
- We'll start with the questionnaire review today and aim to return a completed draft by EOD Jan 23 so procurement has time to review before their Jan 24 cutoff.
- Ben (copied) is our infosec engineering lead — he'll handle the technical attestation rows (network/connectivity, PKI, data handling).
- We can do an asynchronous 12–15 minute recorded walkthrough of the platform tomorrow that excludes live connectivity tests (to avoid showing any customer data). That would let your stakeholders get a feel for the flows while procurement completes the attestation.

If your procurement team is comfortable with that, we can provide the recording plus a short live Q&A (30 minutes) the week of Jan 26. Otherwise we can tentatively hold Jan 27 14:00 ET for a full demo once the questionnaire is approved.

I'll send a DocuSign for the standard NDA now (most customers sign quickly) — please let me know if you need a PO or vendor onboarding portal link instead.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: signed_standard_nda_docusign.pdf
From: Hannah Lytton <hannah.lytton@clearwellhealth.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo — meeting with IT & Procurement on Jan 22

Marcus — that plan sounds workable. Procurement confirms they need a completed questionnaire by EOD Jan 24; if you can return a draft by Jan 23 we'll expedite.

Regarding the demo timing: our exec will be onsite in Boston (ET). For live sessions the team prefers afternoon ET (13:00–16:00 ET). Jan 27 at 14:00 ET would be ideal.

Procurement also asked whether Redwood has a vendor-portal intake URL so they can upload the completed questionnaire and any compliance artifacts; otherwise they requested we email the finished PDF to procurement@clearwellhealth.com.

Here's the HubSpot link for the record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/clearwell/record/CLR-2026-031 (we keep the procurement notes there).

Thanks for getting Ben looped in. If you can share the async recording, mark it "no live connectivity" and we'll circulate it internally while procurement completes the checks.

—Hannah
Attachment: procurement_contact_v2.vcf
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lytton <hannah.lytton@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo — meeting with IT & Procurement on Jan 22

Hannah — confirmed. We've booked Jan 27, 2026 at 14:00 ET for the live demo (calendar invite and dial-in have been sent to your attendees).

Quick status update before the session:
- Ben completed the technical attestation answers and we're returning the questionnaire to you now (please see attached PDF).
- NDA via DocuSign is also completed on our side — link included above.
- I'll upload the completed questionnaire to the vendor portal if you share the intake URL; otherwise I'll email it to procurement@clearwellhealth.com per your preference.

As discussed we'll also share a short 12-minute async recording by EOD tomorrow for internal review; that recording intentionally avoids any live connectivity tests and is intended for exec/stakeholder background. The live session on the 27th will include a 20-minute platform demo + 25-minute Q&A focused on integration and security controls.

If anything changes on your side (audit window or exec travel), please flag it and we can revert to an async-first approach. Looking forward to the session.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v2_completed.pdf
